Top > Characters > Narrator Narrator (ナレーション) The narrator usually speaks at the beginning and ending of each episode. In the beginning of an episode he usually informs the audience of what Satoshi and his friends are doing or where they're heading. Sometimes he'll even explain what they did in the previous episode. He would usually conclude the episode with what Satoshi and company had learned during the episode or say what they were planning to do next. In movies, he usually is only heard at the beginning giving an overview of the Pokémon world. Top > Characters > Asuna Watase Asuna Watase (渡瀬 明日菜) Asuna who has been forced to grow up quickly ever since her father pass away, while her mother, a nurse, works long shifts at a hospital. Asuna spends her solitary days listening to the mysterious music emanating from the cat's-whisker aka crystal detector receiver her father gave to her as a memento, accompanied by pet cat Mimi. One day, a strange creature appears on the surface and nearly kills Asuna. Luckily, a mysterious young man named Shun saves her. From that encounter, Asuna finally learns of the existence of the underworld called "Agartha." However, when Shun suddenly disappears, she ventures out to investigate the underworld. Together with her teacher, Morisaki, Asuna begins her journey to explore "Agartha" and discover the truth behind Shun's disappearance and her own past. At the climax of the story, when Asuna and Shin manage to catch up with Morisaki in the depths of the Finis Terra abyss, Morisaki trades Asuna's soul as a vessel to revive his wife's soul. Fortunately, she is revived thanks to Shin destroying an ancient stone called the "Clavis." Top > Characters > Ringo Roadagain Ringo Roadagain (リンゴォ・ロードアゲイン) Ringo Roadagain is introduced during the 4th Stage of the Steel Ball Run. He traps Gyro, Johnny, and Hot Pants near a cabin located in a forest. Ringo challenges Johnny to kill him, and claims it's the only way to escape. Once Johnny and Hot Pants are bested, he permits Gyro to leave, or enter the "True Man's World." His stand is Mandom. The stand can reverse six seconds of time by turning his wristwatch back six seconds. Voice Actors No voice actors have been added to this character. Top > Characters > Wekapipo Wekapipo (ウェカピポ) Wekapipo is introduced near the end of Stage 6 of the Steel Ball Run race. Originally, he was an imperial guard, but was exiled out of the country by Gyro Zeppeli's father. He now works with the President to get the corpse parts and kill Gyro and Johnny in return for citizenship and residence in the United States as well as a high ranking position in the government. He uses a different type of steel ball called wrecking ball. This is a ball that has 14 "satellites." When used, the shockwaves of being hit by the satellites makes the target loose the sensation in the left side of their body. Voice Actors No voice actors have been added to this character. Top > Characters > Magent Magent Magent Magent (マジェント・マジェント) Magent Magent is one of Funny Valentine's henchmen. He is a Stand User who wields the invulnerable 20th Century Boy. His and Wekapipo's names are both references to the songs of same name by the Japanese rap-group SOUL'd OUT who are known to be fans of JoJo and performed the credits song Voodoo Kingdom for the JJBA: Phantom Blood movie. When first seen, Magent Magent is alongside his partner in crime, Wekapipo, waiting to ambush Gyro and Johnny. His disgusting habits are commonly noted by his partner and upon battle he quickly shows his capabilities by disabling Gyro's steel balls with his defensive Stand. Getting carried away, Gyro is able to outwit him and heavily damage his face, figuring that Magent Magent is dead. This is later shown to be false when Magent Magent ambushes his ex-partner while trying to kill Steven Steel. Magent then wraps himself with dynamite in an attempt to blow Wekapipo up, but the impact sends him into a river where he preserves himself using 20th Century Boy as he hopelessly awaits rescue by Diego. He soon "stops thinking" as neither Diego, nor anyone else, comes to save him, leaving Magent to rest indefinitely at the bottom of the river. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia) Voice Actors No voice actors have been added to this character. Top > Characters > D-I-S-C-O D-I-S-C-O (ディ・ス・コ) D-I-S-C-O is a stand user and he appears to distract Gyro and Johnny and to defeat they with Funny Valentine. His stand is Chocolate Disco. Stand: Chocolate Disco Chocolate Disco appears in the form of a armband with a grid-pattern. When activated, the same type of patterned lines spread from the user's feet, covering about 20 feet in front of him. By pressing a button on the armband, any projectiles or objects can be instantly transported to the corresponding area (Press F5 on armband, object falls on F5). Even if the objects were not moving, they seem to fall with great force and speed. The strength behind this stand is the timing. Top > Characters > Yasuho Hirose Yasuho Hirose (広瀬 康穂) A curious, passionate young woman and the first person to encounter Josuke when he emerges from the earth near the Wall Eyes of Morioh. She gives Josuke his name. Yasuho promptly takes an interest in Josuke and assists him in discovering his true identity. Despite the challenges they encounter, she loyally remains by his side and develops her own combative skills in the process. She reunites with her ex-boyfriend Tooru along the way, who she introduces Josuke to. In the past, Yasuho was ostracized by her fellow classmates and suffered during her parents' divorce, which led to her attempting suicide. This was in part due to her being possessed by a Rock Insect which affected her perception of reality. While recovering within the hospital, Yasuho was cared for by Holy Joestar-Kira. Yasuho seeks out Tooru's help when she's trying to pursue TG University Hospital's head doctor with Josuke. Yasuho learns Tooru isn't who she originally thought he was. Tooru first encountered Yasuho during her childhood, discreetly exploiting her Stand for his own benefit to help him assume the identity of a suitable victim due to his Rock Human nature. Yasuho would eventually forget they ever met as she grew up. Yasuho plays a crucial role in helping Josuke locate the Locacaca and defeating Tooru. Yasuho is a Stand user who wields Paisley Park (ペイズリー・パーク). Paisley Park primarily acts a guide to Yasuho herself or her allies, typically without Yasuho directly commanding it, and is able to manipulate various forms of technology. Top > Characters > Joushuu Higashikata Joushuu Higashikata (東方 常秀) The second youngest Higashikata sibling and arguably the most spoiled. His typical disrespectful, selfish behavior is subdued with his older brother Joubin, whom he admires and seeks the approval of. He also gets into petty arguments with older sister Hato. Joushuu first meets Jousuke when he emerges from the earth near the Wall Eyes of Morioh before he's adopted into the Higashikata family, interrupting Joushuu's comfortable lifestyle. Joushuu's hostility towards Jousuke is fuled by the twisted romantic feelings he harbors for his childhood friend and crush, Yasuho, who constantly declines his advances and prefers Josuke. Surprisingly, Joushuu is a university student majoring in sociology. He has a fear of flying in a plane and doesn't believe in god either. Joushuu is a Stand user who wields Nut King Call (ナット・キング・コール). Its ability allows it to conjure nuts and bolts, which can then be embedded into targets, including other humans, to disassemble them into pieces, or connect them together. The ability automatically loses affect once the target is out of range. Joushuu displays some rare moments of strategic intelligence and heroicness, albeit for his own benefit, such as when he undergoes an equivalent exchange with Yasuho without realizing the severity of it. Top > Characters > Jousuke Higashikata Jousuke Higashikata (東方 定助) Seemingly a sailor who is amnesiac about all details of his personal life. For some reason he has 4 testicles. The real identity of this character is unknown. The second chapter stated that the Jojolion protagonist's name could be Yoshikage Kira, however it is later revealed that he is merely a doppelganger for the real Kira. He was later given the name Jousuke by the Higashikata family, who took him in. Jousuke's original identity was that of Josefumi Kuujou, and became his current self after fusing with the man Yoshikage Kira. However, DNA testing implies that Jousuke and Kuujou are nearly the same person. Stand: Soft & Wet Releases a bubble from Jousuke's birthmark. When the bubble pops near something, it "steals" something from that thing. For example, stealing the water from somebody will make the target thirsty. Jousuke can't use this ability on himself.
